newsitem.title: MEXICO: Ex-Salinas prosecutor charged in body-snatch case.
newsitem.headline: Ex-Salinas prosecutor charged in body-snatch case.

text.p: The former chief prosecutor who jailed the brother of ex-President Carlos Salinas on murder charges was himself charged with criminal association, evidence-rigging and body-snatching on Tuesday, authorities said.
Pablo Chapa Bezanilla, who was fired from his job as special prosecutor at the Attorney General's Office in December, has been a fugitive for the last month.

A spokesman for the Mexico City Attorney General said Chapa, through his lawyers, had obtained an "amparo" -- a court order protecting him from illegal arrest -- which would provisionally suspend the arrest warrant against him.
Under the terms of the court order, Chapa may now testify to the judge who ordered him arrested, without being detained.
Chapa has said he is being persecuted for political reasons and asked for human rights observers from Mexico and abroad to attend if he turns himself in.
Before Tuesday, Chapa had been fleeing a lesser court order requiring him to testify about allegations of bribery.
The spokesman said Chapa had now been charged with "criminal association, false reports to authorities ... violation of laws governing burial and exhumation of bodies ..."

The charges arise from the discovery of a skeleton late last year at a ranch used by Raul Salinas, the ex-president's brother, whom Chapa arrested in February 1995 on charges of masterminding the murder of Jose Francisco Ruiz Massieu, a top leader of the ruling Institutional Revolutionary Party.
Chapa claimed the body was that of a missing congressman, believed murdered, who was wanted on charges of helping Raul Salinas plan the killing.
Investigators found, though, that the body had been planted and was actually that of a relative of a witch and soothsayer known as "Paca" who was helping Chapa with the probe.

The witch and several of her relatives have been charged with illegally digging up the body at a municipal cemetery and reburying it at the ranch. The charges against Chapa stem from his alleged involvement in their actions.
Raul Salinas also faces embezzlement charges following the discovery of more than $100 million in bank accounts abroad. He denies all the charges against him.
